basic_info.description: Nestled in the sunny Candlestick Point neighborhood of San Francisco, 301 Crescent Ct #3411 offers a perfect blend of comfort and convenience. This rarely available TOP FLOOR 1-bedroom condo boasts picturesque bay/water views, providing a peaceful retreat within the city's vibrant energy. The bright, east-facing living area is bathed in natural light, with an open-concept layout that seamlessly connects the living room, balcony, dining area, and kitchen - perfect for modern living. The spacious bedroom features double walk-through closets, an en suite bathroom, and in-unit laundry for added convenience. Additional highlights include a designated 1-car garage parking on the ground floor, elevator to all levels, access to the community gym, and a lively, fun BBQ area - ideal for entertaining. Oh, and No Neighbor Upstairs. The condo complex also offers free Bart Shuttle service as well as gated access with security, providing peace of mind in this vibrant community. Don't miss the chance to make this beautiful condo your new home in San Francisco!
